programme.title: Ben Fogle: Paluu villiin
programme.desc: Adventurer Ben Fogle meets people who have turned their backs on Western society and set up home in some of the most isolated locations on Earth.

programme.title: Evoluutio
programme.desc: How did the ostrich come to lay the biggest egg on Earth? Chris Packham explores the way reproduction has shaped life on Earth and the surprising evolutionary origins of sex, eggs and birds. It's a four billion year journey contained within a shell.

programme.title: Evoluutio
programme.desc: How did the bat get so hungry? Chris Packham sets out to answer a deceptively simple question: how the drive to find food shaped life on Earth and gave rise to one of nature’s most insatiable feeders. This is the story of the origin of bums, guts, jaws and super-hearing, and a 500-million-year chain of innovation, survival and hunger.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
programme.desc: Early reports gave the gorilla a fearsome reputation and the vampire bat also gave rise to horrific stories and myths. However, the true nature of these animals turned out to be very different.

programme.title: Ben Fogle: Paluu villiin

programme.title: W świecie luksusu
Inside the World's Most Luxurious

programme.title: Kurorty sławnych i bogatych
Playgrounds of the Rich and Famous
programme.desc: Twórcy filmu sprawdzają, gdzie wypoczywają bogaci ludzie. Gwiazdy i celebryci odwiedzają m.in. Saint-Tropez, za którym przepadała Brigitte Bardot, oraz karaibską wyspę Saint- Barthélemy.

programme.title: Najpiękniej ukryte hotele
The World's Most Secret Hotels
programme.desc: Wizyta w niezwykłych kurortach i hotelach. W Urugwaju twórcy odwiedzą lustrzane domki, w Szwecji - chatki hobbitów inspirowane wizją Tolkiena, w Norfolk pokażą dwustuletni Cley Windmill.
